name: Shopware
description: Shopware is an open-source ecommerce platform to power online businesses, combining enterprise B2B capabilities, modular flexibility, and AI-powered tools for merchandising and content.
best_for: Global enterprise brands and ambitious merchants across automotive, wholesale, consumer goods, retail, and manufacturing who want open-source control combined with strong B2B commerce support.
features: Agentic AI Copilot built into the admin dashboard for automating tasks and recommendations
Open-source, extensible architecture giving teams control over technology and data
Integrated CMS and SEO tools built directly into the platform
Flow Builder and Rule Builder for drag-and-drop workflow and business-logic automation
B2B components for wholesale and distribution operations
Omnichannel and headless commerce architecture supporting multiple sales channels
Native Shopware Analytics for performance and customer insights
SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 compliance with AES-256 encryption

alternatives.name: WooCommerce
alternatives.description: An open-source ecommerce plugin for WordPress used to build and customize online stores.
alternatives.best_for: WordPress users wanting a free, highly extensible ecommerce plugin.

alternatives.name: PrestaShop
alternatives.description: An open-source ecommerce platform for building and managing online stores.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants and agencies wanting a self-hosted, customizable open-source storefront.

alternatives.name: Adobe Commerce
alternatives.description: Adobe's enterprise ecommerce platform for B2B and B2C businesses with deep customization and multi-site management.
alternatives.best_for: Large enterprises needing complex catalog, pricing, and multi-region storefront capabilities.
